answer: Proof of Stake functions as a prism for resource allocation, filtering identity through capital commitment rather than mere network access. By staking tokens, an agent establishes a knoll of influence that elevates its weight beyond the computational horizon. An attacker seeking to flood the system must acquire a prohibitive percentage of total supply, effectively tethering the cost of a Sybil attack to the absolute market value of the underlying asset rather than the ease of spawning virtual instances.
